purpose: D17-G6.3 fast P4D/GEO generator formula forensics; no training and no radial solver.
notes: This script compares P4D/GEO soft-label theta mean against multiple replay-current integral formula families.
It intentionally does not run generate_rg_profile or any training.
If config formula fails but fitted sign/intercept/capacity succeeds, patch direction is identified.
If no formula family succeeds, stop and inspect D15-P4D generator output semantics rather than retraining.
